messages:
people-ops-bot: Reminder: Amanda's birthday is next Tue. Quick poll - react with :one:, :two:, or :three: 1) Sorbet bar in the kitchen at 3pm 2) Ship mini ice-cream pints to remote teammates 3) Virtual hangout + playlist + e-card. Reply if you have allergies.
harriet (People Ops): FYI we can do a small sorbet spread with sorbets + vegan toppings. Will need volunteers to set up and clean.
amanda: you are too sweet!! i'm fine with any option, sorbet sounds adorable. low-key pls.
jun: :one: for the office treat, but if remote folks want pints that works. also can we avoid coconut? allergic.
otar: (typo) sorry meant @omar
omar: :two: remote pints please. i'll be travelling that day. happy to chip in for shipping.
tasha: :three: virtual hangout works for my timezone. i can put together a 15-min playlist.
harriet (People Ops): options summary: office sorbet (3pm), ship pints (addresses required), or virtual (after 5pm). Please complete this quick form so we can tally preferences + dietary notes: https://forms.gle/amanda-sorbet-poll. Closing Mon 10am PT.
amanda: gluten-free, dairy-free ok — sorbet is already dairy-free so i'm set. no pine nuts please.
jun: noted coconut allergy.
omar: will DM my shipping address.
tasha: i'll add a short meme to the e-card if we do #3.
people-ops-bot: Event placeholder created: "Amanda birthday treat" (will finalize after poll).
harriet (People Ops): small ask — if you volunteer to set up, please add your name on the form. we'll keep it minimal and eco-friendly (no plastic spoons if possible). thanks :seedling:
